definitions.gsb_side: Eksakt match mellem team.name_raw og home_name_raw/away_name_raw for teamets tilknyttede GSB-klub (club_id 1093).
definitions.age_group: competition.age_group_id som turneringskontekst; ikke fødselsår eller entydig alder.
definitions.player_count: Distinct normalized player_id på den udledte GSB-side; fysisk personantal er ukendt jf. opgave 164.
definitions.new_player_proxy: ID observeret i 2025/26, men ikke i 2024/25; må ikke kaldes nye personer.
definitions.suppression: Ingen tabelcelle med under fem observationer vises; hele fordelingen skjules hvis en celle falder under fem for at undgå differensslutning.

candidate_metrics.name: Holdkampe med GSB-hold
candidate_metrics.query:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS matches,
      COUNT(DISTINCT tm.gsb_team_id) AS teams,
      SUM(tm.status = 'browser_verified') AS browser_verified,
      SUM(tm.status = 'api_error') AS api_errors
    FROM team_matches tm JOIN teams t ON t.team_id = tm.gsb_team_id
    WHERE tm.season_id = 2025 AND t.club_id = 1093
candidate_metrics.caveat: Omfatter alle kampstatusser; fire kampe har api_error.

candidate_metrics.name: Kampresultater med browser-verificeret status
candidate_metrics.query:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS matches,
      COUNT(DISTINCT tm.gsb_team_id) AS teams,
      SUM(tm.status = 'browser_verified') AS browser_verified,
      SUM(tm.status = 'api_error') AS api_errors
    FROM team_matches tm JOIN teams t ON t.team_id = tm.gsb_team_id
    WHERE tm.season_id = 2025 AND t.club_id = 1093
candidate_metrics.caveat: Dækker statusfeltet, ikke en separat kontrol af hvert resultat.

candidate_metrics.name: Hold med mindst én kamp
candidate_metrics.query:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS matches,
      COUNT(DISTINCT tm.gsb_team_id) AS teams,
      SUM(tm.status = 'browser_verified') AS browser_verified,
      SUM(tm.status = 'api_error') AS api_errors
    FROM team_matches tm JOIN teams t ON t.team_id = tm.gsb_team_id
    WHERE tm.season_id = 2025 AND t.club_id = 1093
candidate_metrics.caveat: Tæller hold-ID’er i sæsonen, ikke nødvendigvis aktive hold ved sæsonslut.

candidate_metrics.name: Individuelle kampe i GSB-holdkampe
candidate_metrics.query:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT im.individual_match_id) AS individual_games
    FROM individual_matches im JOIN team_matches tm USING (team_match_id)
    JOIN teams t ON t.team_id = tm.gsb_team_id
    WHERE tm.season_id = 2025 AND t.club_id = 1093
candidate_metrics.caveat: Tæller single- og doublekampe på begge sider af GSB-holdkampene.

candidate_metrics.name: Spilleroptrædener på GSB-siden
candidate_metrics.query:
WITH g AS (
      SELECT tm.team_match_id, t.name_raw,
        CASE WHEN tm.home_name_raw = t.name_raw THEN 'home'
             WHEN tm.away_name_raw = t.name_raw THEN 'away' END AS gsb_side
      FROM team_matches tm JOIN teams t ON t.team_id = tm.gsb_team_id
      WHERE tm.season_id = 2025 AND t.club_id = 1093
    )
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS appearances, COUNT(DISTINCT imp.player_id) AS player_ids,
      COUNT(DISTINCT im.individual_match_id) AS individual_games
    FROM g JOIN individual_matches im USING (team_match_id)
    JOIN individual_match_players imp USING (individual_match_id)
    WHERE imp.side = g.gsb_side
candidate_metrics.caveat: Side bestemt via eksakt holdnavn; tæller en spiller én gang pr. individuel kamp.

candidate_metrics.name: Observerede spiller-ID’er på GSB-siden
candidate_metrics.query:
WITH g AS (
      SELECT tm.team_match_id, t.name_raw,
        CASE WHEN tm.home_name_raw = t.name_raw THEN 'home'
             WHEN tm.away_name_raw = t.name_raw THEN 'away' END AS gsb_side
      FROM team_matches tm JOIN teams t ON t.team_id = tm.gsb_team_id
      WHERE tm.season_id = 2025 AND t.club_id = 1093
    )
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS appearances, COUNT(DISTINCT imp.player_id) AS player_ids,
      COUNT(DISTINCT im.individual_match_id) AS individual_games
    FROM g JOIN individual_matches im USING (team_match_id)
    JOIN individual_match_players imp USING (individual_match_id)
    WHERE imp.side = g.gsb_side
candidate_metrics.caveat: Ikke et bevist antal fysiske personer; aliaser og ID-koblinger er uafklarede jf. 164.

candidate_metrics.query:
WITH g AS (

candidate_metrics.name: Antal aldersgrupper med GSB-holdkampe
candidate_metrics.query:
SELECT c.age_group_id, COUNT(DISTINCT tm.team_match_id) AS matches,
      COUNT(DISTINCT tm.gsb_team_id) AS teams
    FROM team_matches tm JOIN teams t ON t.team_id = tm.gsb_team_id
    JOIN competitions c ON c.competition_id = tm.competition_id
    WHERE tm.season_id = 2025 AND t.club_id = 1093
    GROUP BY c.age_group_id ORDER BY c.age_group_id
candidate_metrics.caveat: Antallet er turneringsgrupper, ikke spilleralder; under-fem-hold-celler skjules.

candidate_metrics.name: Observerede spiller-ID pr. aldersgruppe
candidate_metrics.query:
WITH g AS (
      SELECT tm.team_match_id, t.name_raw,
        CASE WHEN tm.home_name_raw = t.name_raw THEN 'home'
             WHEN tm.away_name_raw = t.name_raw THEN 'away' END AS gsb_side
      FROM team_matches tm JOIN teams t ON t.team_id = tm.gsb_team_id
      WHERE tm.season_id = 2025 AND t.club_id = 1093
    )
    SELECT c.age_group_id, COUNT(DISTINCT imp.player_id) AS player_ids
    FROM g JOIN individual_matches im USING (team_match_id)
    JOIN individual_match_players imp USING (individual_match_id)
    JOIN team_matches tm USING (team_match_id)
    JOIN competitions c USING (competition_id)
    WHERE imp.side = g.gsb_side
    GROUP BY c.age_group_id ORDER BY c.age_group_id
candidate_metrics.caveat: Aldersgrupper overlapper. ID-tal er ikke fysisk personantal; kan ikke bruges som alderstrin pr. person.

candidate_metrics.name: Først observerede spiller-ID’er i forhold til forrige sæson
candidate_metrics.query:
WITH g AS (
      SELECT tm.season_id, tm.team_match_id, t.name_raw,
        CASE WHEN tm.home_name_raw = t.name_raw THEN 'home'
             WHEN tm.away_name_raw = t.name_raw THEN 'away' END AS gsb_side
      FROM team_matches tm JOIN teams t ON t.team_id = tm.gsb_team_id
      WHERE tm.season_id IN (2024, 2025) AND t.club_id = 1093
    ), people AS (
      SELECT g.season_id, imp.player_id FROM g
      JOIN individual_matches im USING (team_match_id)
      JOIN individual_match_players imp USING (individual_match_id)
      WHERE imp.side = g.gsb_side GROUP BY g.season_id, imp.player_id
    )
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS ids_2025, SUM(NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM people old WHERE old.season_id = 2024 AND old.player_id = cur.player_id
      )) AS first_observed_ids
    FROM people cur WHERE cur.season_id = 2025
candidate_metrics.caveat: Ikke nye personer: manglende kampe, ændrede ID’er og historisk dækning kan ligne tilgang.

candidate_metrics.name: Rangliste ID total i liste 288 (10. april 2026)
candidate_metrics.query:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT player_id) AS player_ids, ROUND(AVG(points), 1) AS mean_points
    FROM ranking_points WHERE list_id = 288 AND version_date = '2026-04-10' AND LOWER(club) LIKE '%gladsaxe%'
candidate_metrics.caveat: ID-total er ikke bevist personantal; M/K-celler skjules, fordi personkobling ikke er afklaret.

candidate_metrics.name: Gennemsnitlige point samlet i liste 288
candidate_metrics.query:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT player_id) AS player_ids, ROUND(AVG(points), 1) AS mean_points
    FROM ranking_points WHERE list_id = 288 AND version_date = '2026-04-10' AND LOWER(club) LIKE '%gladsaxe%'
candidate_metrics.caveat: Afhænger af snapshotdato; parametrene M/K er ikke bekræftet personkøn.

candidate_metrics.name: GSB-holdkampenes ligaomfang
candidate_metrics.query:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.competition_id) AS competitions,
      COUNT(DISTINCT tm.gsb_team_id) AS teams,
      COUNT(DISTINCT c.age_group_id) AS age_groups
    FROM team_matches tm JOIN teams t ON t.team_id = tm.gsb_team_id
    JOIN competitions c ON c.competition_id = tm.competition_id
    WHERE tm.season_id = 2025 AND t.club_id = 1093
candidate_metrics.caveat: Competition ID er sæsonspecifik og svarer til en kilde-/turneringsrække.

candidate_metrics.name: Nationalt registreret liga-landskab
candidate_metrics.query:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT league_group_id) AS groups,
      COUNT(*) AS team_rows, COUNT(DISTINCT team_name_raw) AS distinct_team_names
    FROM league_group_teams WHERE season_id = 2025
candidate_metrics.caveat: National kontekst, ikke et GSB-resultat; rå pulje- og holdrækker kan indeholde dubletter på tværs af grupper.

candidate_metrics.name: GSB-holdkampe fra 2024/25 til 2025/26
candidate_metrics.query:
SELECT tm.season_id, COUNT(*) AS matches, COUNT(DISTINCT tm.gsb_team_id) AS teams
    FROM team_matches tm JOIN teams t ON t.team_id = tm.gsb_team_id
    WHERE tm.season_id IN (2024, 2025) AND t.club_id = 1093
    GROUP BY tm.season_id ORDER BY tm.season_id
candidate_metrics.caveat: Må ikke fortolkes som vækst uden kontrol af ensartet historisk datadækning.

recommended_page.rationale: De viser aktivitet, kampdækning, antal hold, omfanget af spillede kampe, alders-/turneringsbredde og udvikling i registreret aktivitet uden at rangere eller identificere spillere. Vis 2024/25→2025/26 som datadækningsjusteret indikator og først efter sammenlignelighedskontrol.
recommended_page.exclusions: Afhængighederne 163/164 giver ikke sikkert fysisk personantal, fødselsår, personkøn eller stabil historisk ID-identitet. Disse kan vises internt som datakvalitetsmål, men bør ikke stå som bestyrelsesfakta endnu.
